dependency_lock.$comment: Pinned external dependencies for Rebuild Studio on Windows. Consumed by scripts/windows/Setup-Dependencies.ps1 and Doctor-RebuildStudio.ps1. An artifact with sha256 == null is NEVER installed (verify_required). Compute with: Setup-Dependencies.ps1 -ComputeHash <tool>, review the source, then paste the value here.

webview2_evergreen_bootstrapper.role: Required by Tauri on Windows. Evergreen runtime is NOT bundled; Install-RebuildStudio.ps1 checks for it and downloads the small bootstrapper if absent.
webview2_evergreen_bootstrapper.hash_note: Microsoft re-publishes this bootstrapper under a stable URL, so the hash changes; instead of a hash the installer REQUIRES a valid Authenticode signature from 'Microsoft Corporation' (Get-AuthenticodeSignature) before running it.

vc_redist_x64.role: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime (needed by the Rust MSVC binary, PyInstaller bundle, rizin MSVC build). Detected only; Doctor prints the download link, nothing is bundled.

rust.note: CI uses the stable channel; the pin records the version the shell was validated with (cargo check on Linux). Windows MSVC builds are unverified until docs/WINDOWS_RELEASE_GATES.md gate W1 passes.

python.note: CI (windows.yml, linux.yml) and the PyInstaller sidecar build use 3.12. The Linux dev host that wrote the controller ran 3.13.16; both are exercised by linux.yml's pytest matrix. 3.11 is the declared floor in controller/pyproject.toml but is not exercised.
